fixes.new:
A soldier belonging to the $$アンタレス$$ Squadron of the $$ギャラクシー船団$$. Rank: major.
With a fully cyborgized body, he calmly handles even machines that subject the pilot to G forces ordinary humans could not endure. Weapons are also built into his body, and his unarmed combat ability is high.
Wearing a black long coat and sunglasses, he guards $$シェリル$$.
With his consciousness controlled by the $$ギャラクシー船団幹部$$, he killed $$三島$$ and others, and on the $$バジュラ$$ homeworld rode a VF-27 Gamma and stood in $$アルト$$'s way.
Triggered by $$アルト$$'s '$$光の舞$$', he broke free of the mind control and made a suicide charge into the CIC of $$バトル・フロンティア$$, where the $$ギャラクシー船団幹部$$ were.
fixes.reason: pronoun/pro-drop: Brera is male per the brief (wiki infobox); the repeated token as subject came from the old no-pronoun rule and is replaced with he/his; 'the body' -> 'his body', 'unarmed combat ability' -> 'his unarmed combat ability' (same meaning)

fixes.new:
Chief researcher at the $$ゲッター線$$ research institute of the $$国際機密連合$$.
He was formerly involved in the development of Getter Robo together with $$早乙女$$ and $$敷島$$.
Always acting alongside $$スティンガー$$, the two call each other by name with the suffix '-kun'.
$$コーウェン$$ was parasitized on the Moon by the parent $$インベーダー#robot$$ and worked behind the scenes to make the Earth the property of the $$インベーダー#robot$$s. In the decisive battle at Jupiter, $$コーウェン$$ and $$スティンガー$$ fused together with a giant $$インベーダー#robot$$ and stood in the way of $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$ and Shin Getter.
fixes.reason: pro-drop: the Japanese is a full sentence whose subject (the entry's own person, Cowen, male) was dropped; subject restored

fixes.new:
One of $$ボス$$'s henchmen.
Despite his vacant expression and runny nose, which give no hint of it, he is a master of drunken fist boxing with championship-level skill in Japan.
When he made quick work of Iron Mask with that skill, $$甲児$$ said of him and $$ムチャ$$ together that 'they might be stronger than $$ボス$$'.
fixes.reason: mistranslation: the Japanese says Kouji's remark about being stronger than Boss was about Nuke and Mucha together (ムチャと合わせ); the English 'he might be stronger' made it about Nuke alone

fixes.new:
One of $$ボス$$'s henchmen.
His small stature and obedience to $$ボス$$ make him look like nothing more than a hanger-on at first glance, but he is actually a master of finger-flicking projectiles. He once nailed Iron Mask square in the face with a firecracker pellet faster than the man could level his gun, proof that his skill is the real thing.
fixes.reason: addition: the Japanese only says 実は指弾の名手 (master of shidan, finger-flicked projectiles); 'firecracker pellets' belongs to the next sentence and 'with pinpoint speed' is not in the Japanese
